headings.usage: H1, H2, H3, large titles, and stylistic overlines
headings.instruction: Headings must be elegant and fine. Use font-light (300) for large page titles. Ensure tracking is slightly loose for uppercase overlines.

body_and_tables.usage: All body text, financial tables, forms, buttons, and dense UI elements
body_and_tables.instruction: CRITICAL: The body and all financial tables MUST remain in Calibri (non-negotiable). Do NOT use Montserrat for dense data.

scales.h1_hero: text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-light tracking-tight text-[#063044] dark:text-white
scales.overline: text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#808080] dark:text-gray-400

primary.name: Navy
primary.usage: Large titles, text, secondary buttons, active sidebar items, table grand totals.

secondary.name: Teal
secondary.usage: Primary CTA buttons, thin vertical separator lines, active state accents.

accent.name: Golden Orange
accent.usage: Badges, alerts, warning states, sparkline highlights.

login_hero.structure: Split screen. Left: 50% width on desktop. Right: 50% width form.
login_hero.left_panel: Full-frame image with heavy dark corporate overlay (bg-[#063044]/80). Inside, a thin border box (border-white/20 p-8 or p-12). Contains an overline 'CARRIÈRES', a large thin H1 title with a keyword highlighted/underlined in #15AF97.

buttons.primary: bg-[#15AF97] hover:bg-[#15AF97]/90 text-white rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-body font-medium transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-[#063044] hover:bg-[#063044]/90 text-white rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-body transition-colors
buttons.outline: border border-[#063044] text-[#063044] dark:border-white dark:text-white hover:bg-[#063044] hover:text-white dark:hover:bg-white dark:hover:text-[#063044] rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-body transition-colors

cards.kpi: bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-md shadow-sm border border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-700 p-6. Top accent border or left accent line in #15AF97.
cards.dashboard_sections: Use very light gray background for the main dashboard area. Cards are clean white. Use fine vertical lines (border-l border-[#15AF97] pl-4) to separate key columns or stats.

financial_tables.instruction: Do NOT redefine logic of rows. Keep body in Calibri. Harmonize containers with clean white backgrounds, minimal borders. Subtotals row: text-[#808080] dark:text-gray-400 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800/50. Grand totals row: bg-[#063044] text-white font-bold.

sidebar.layout: Fixed left sidebar. 2 main groups: 'Masse salariale', 'Comptabilité'.
sidebar.active_item: bg-[#063044]/5 text-[#063044] dark:bg-[#15AF97]/10 dark:text-[#15AF97] border-r-2 border-[#15AF97] font-medium

page_headers.layout: Flex container, generous padding (pt-8 pb-4). Includes uppercase overline (#808080), large thin title (#063044), and optional subtitle.

layouts_and_spacing.general: Generous whitespace. Avoid cramped elements. Use p-6, p-8, and p-12 for section paddings.
layouts_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: Bento style or dense grid for KPI cards (gap-6), but maintain breathable padding inside cards.
layouts_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align form labels, table headers (except numbers), and section titles. Center-align only inside specific bounded cards if appropriate.

motion.hover_states: Subtle opacity or background color shifts. No heavy transforms. Use transition-colors duration-200.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #063044 and #15AF97 maintain at least 4.5:1 ratio against light backgrounds. Use white text strictly inside teal and navy buttons.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Prioritize using pre-existing Shadcn components from src/components/ui.
Use standard Tailwind classes. Include dark mode variants (dark:bg-..., dark:text-...).
Never apply transition: all globally. Apply to specific interactive elements.
Create depth with subtle layered elements, minimal shadow-sm, and clean borders. Avoid messy gradients.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds where text overlaps images. Always use an overlay or glassmorphism.
Do NOT center align the app container. Respect left-aligned reading flows.
For the login page, create a beautiful corporate split screen. Replicate the reference site hero feeling on the left panel. The right panel has the login form.
Use Poppins or Montserrat for titles, and ONLY use Calibri for the body text, tables, inputs, and standard UI.
Remember to apply data-testid to elements to facilitate testing.
